Chapter 408 - 408 Super Batteries; Buying Clothes! (1)

408 Super Batteries; Buying Clothes! (1)

Lin Fan had no idea what Wang Fugui was thinking.

At this moment…

Lin Fan drove the Cullinan to Jiangbei University, which he had not seen for a long time.

He did not choose to go to the classroom. Instead, he walked past the basketball court and went straight to the teaching building.

Even though Lin Fan had only been here once, with his photographic memory, he was as familiar with the entire teaching building as he was with his home.

Soon, Lin Fan arrived at the entrance of the chemistry teaching room and slowly pushed the door open.

Professor Zhao Xueqin and Professor Li Rongfa were leading three Ph.D. students to study something carefully.

After a long time of research, Zhao Xueqin’s mouth was dry. He turned around and picked up the thermos cup to drink a mouthful of goji berry water.

In the next moment…

“Lin Fan!” Zhao Xueqin suddenly shouted excitedly.”

As soon as he said that, Li Rongfa and the three Ph.D. students stopped their research and looked at Lin Fan.

Lin Fan coughed lightly and said, “Uh… Am I disturbing you?”

“No, no,” Zhao Xueqin said.

“Why would you be disturbing us?” Li Rongfa asked. “We’re so happy that you’re here to guide the experiment.”

Zhao Xueqin replied, “That’s right!”

Their words were extremely sincere.

They still remembered clearly that Lin Fan had come to the laboratory for a stroll not long ago.

Then…

He wrote a paper on the principle and usage of super batteries and successfully published it in Science!

This thesis changed the mobile phone industry.

At the same time, it allowed the field of battery to take a big step forward!

What made Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa even happier was…

Lin Fan had actually put their names as the second author!

It was also because of this that Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa had recently become famous in the school and even the entire chemistry world!

This was the most glorious moment they had ever had in their lives!

Now, Lin Fan had come to the laboratory.

If he invented something or even wrote a thesis…

Thinking of this, Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa were excited.

“What are Professor Zhao and Professor Li researching now?” Lin Fan asked.

“The chemistry community unanimously believes that your super battery has already pushed the limits of small-scale batteries to what’s attainable in this century,” Zhao Xueqin hurriedly said.

“Therefore, we’ve recently stopped researching small-scale batteries and changed our direction to new energy vehicle batteries.”

Li Rongfa chimed in, “Yes, but since we’ve just started this project, everything is only in the initial stage.”

The two of them scrambled to answer.

It was as if they were trying to answer first.

After saying that…

The two of them looked at Lin Fan expectantly.

They were looking forward to Lin Fan giving them some guidance and help.

When had the students in the laboratory ever seen the two professors like this?

It was like a conversation between a student and a teacher.

However, none of them had any strange expressions.

That was because Lin Fan was publicly acknowledged as the number one person in chemistry!

Compared to the anticipation of the crowd, Lin Fan had a weird look on his face.

He had just received a mission regarding energy vehicle batteries.

It turned out that they just happened to be researching new energy vehicle batteries?

What a coincidence!

After a while, Lin Fan said, “Have you done any experiments?”

“We’ve already done material experiments and high-temperature experiments,” Zhao Xueqin said hurriedly.

“Next, we’re also preparing to do different kinds of efficiency experiments, high-molecular experiments, and so on,” Li Rongfa added.

Lin Fan did not bother with Li Rongfa’s words. As long as he had done experiments, it was fine!

His mission was to watch an experiment!

Lin Fan said, “Then you guys can experiment with the materials and show me what you’ve done.”

“Alright!” Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa said in unison.”

“Hurry up and prepare the experimental materials!” Zhao Xueqin turned around and said to the students.

“Everyone, get your spirits up. Treat this experiment as a graduation assessment!” Li Rongfa said.

“Yes, Sir!” the students shouted.

In fact, there was no need for the two of them to remind them.

The students also knew that this was a rare opportunity.

After all, Lin Fan was the number one person in terms of chemical batteries.

He was a big shot among big shots!

If they could get some pointers by doing experiments in front of him, it would definitely be a very rare opportunity!

Soon, the students sorted the different materials in order, including heating, compressing, and vaporizing.

The materials emitted different colors of light.

Then, a twisting curve appeared on the computer screen.

Half an hour later, the experiment slowly ended.

“Lin Fan, which material do you think is the most suitable?” Li Rongfa asked with anticipation.

After he finished speaking, Zhao Qin and the other professors looked at Lin Fan expectantly.

Lin Fan did not answer immediately but focused on the mission.

[Ding! Mission: Watch a battery experiment (1/1). Read The Safety Analysis of Electric Vehicle Power Batteries, The Engineering of Batteries, The Technology Basics of Electric Vehicles, The Powertrain of Electric Vehicles, and The Theory of Vehicle Batteries (0/5). Reward: One ultra-speed battery, as well as its detailed research and development data, principles, etc., and your chemistry experience will be upgraded.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s lips curled up.

Half of the mission was completed!

Then, Lin Fan said, “I need to think about the specific materials.”

After saying that, he turned around and left the laboratory.

“Alright, goodbye, Lin Fan,” Zhao Xueqin raised his voice and said.
